card.text: Explore Golevka in 3D with its published radar shape model.

introduction.text: Golevka is a near-Earth asteroid whose radar reconstruction has angular faces, sharp edges and large concavities. Explore its original shape and radial heights. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Radar shape resolved at tens of metres. Its angular edges are modeled; no optical texture is mapped.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Radar height relative to a 265 m sphere. Colors include the overall form; pixels add no measured detail.
